---
title: "Public Data Processing Templates"
---

SWFSC CoastWatch maintains two **public, sanitized GitHub templates** for groups that also process data on GCP. They are optional starting points: an ERDDAP deployment does not need either template. Each repository contains example files and placeholders that must be adapted to the new project.

| Template | Choose it when | Repository |
|---|---|---|
| Cloud Run Job | A container should run a batch workflow on demand or on a schedule. | [cloud-run-template](https://github.com/erd-coastwatch/cloud-run-template) |
| Processing VM | A workflow runs directly on a VM, with scripts, notebooks, and a persistent workspace. | [vm-dataproc-template](https://github.com/erd-coastwatch/vm-dataproc-template) |

## Cloud Run Job template

The [Cloud Run template](https://github.com/erd-coastwatch/cloud-run-template) includes a `Dockerfile`, `entrypoint.sh`, `deploy_job.sh`, and example `config/`, `scripts/`, `src/`, and `templates/` directories. Its deployment script contains project, region, image, service account, and secret placeholders. Review the entire script and replace those values before running it; it can create cloud resources and deploy a job.

Start with the repository's [README](https://github.com/erd-coastwatch/cloud-run-template/blob/main/README.md), then use **Use this template** on GitHub to create a repository for your workflow. Add your processing code, configure its GCP identity and storage permissions, and review the deployment script against your organization's infrastructure ownership.

## Processing VM template

The [processing VM template](https://github.com/erd-coastwatch/vm-dataproc-template) provides example `config/`, `notebooks/`, `scripts/`, `src/`, `data/`, `docs/`, `logs/`, `templates/`, and `tests/` directories. Its `data/` directory contains an example file; it is **not** a preconfigured link to a persistent disk. Choose the storage layout and mount paths appropriate for your project.

First establish the VM, disk, service account, and required storage access using [Optional Processing VM Setup](gcp-processing-vm.qmd). Then follow the template's [README](https://github.com/erd-coastwatch/vm-dataproc-template/blob/main/README.md) and use **Use this template** to create your workflow repository. The template organizes code and documentation; it does not provision a VM or install a scientific environment.

## Create a repository from a template

Open the [Cloud Run template](https://github.com/erd-coastwatch/cloud-run-template) or [processing VM template](https://github.com/erd-coastwatch/vm-dataproc-template) on GitHub. Select **Use this template → Create a new repository**, choose the repository owner and name, and create it. Clone your new repository, then replace the example configuration and files with your workflow’s code and settings. Review any deployment script before running it against your GCP project.
